options: A human watches the model train in real time
Every training example is paired with a known correct output (a label)
The model is only used for classification, never regression
It requires reinforcement signals during training
questions.explain: Supervised learning is named for the labels: each training example includes the correct answer, which supervises what the model should learn to predict.

questions.q: A retailer feeds a model 50,000 unlabeled customer purchase histories and asks it to find natural groupings. What type of learning is this?
options: Reinforcement learning
Supervised regression
Unsupervised learning
Supervised classification
questions.explain: With no labels supplied, and the goal being to discover structure (like clusters) in the data itself, this is unsupervised learning.

questions.q: In reinforcement learning, what signal does the agent use to improve its behavior over time?
options: A dataset of correct actions labeled in advance
Reward and penalty signals received after taking actions in an environment
A loss function computed against ground-truth labels
Clusters discovered in unlabeled data
questions.explain: Reinforcement learning has no pre-labeled correct actions. The agent learns by acting, observing a reward or penalty and a new state, and adjusting its strategy to earn more reward over time.

questions.q: Why does most applied business ML lean on supervised learning rather than reinforcement learning?
options: Reinforcement learning cannot run on business data at all
Supervised learning never requires any historical data
Businesses usually already have labeled historical data (what actually happened), while reinforcement learning needs a repeatable environment to interact with
Unsupervised learning is illegal to use commercially
questions.explain: Labeled historical outcomes (did this transaction turn out to be fraud, did this customer churn) are often already sitting in a database, which is exactly what supervised learning needs. Reinforcement learning instead needs an environment the agent can repeatedly act in.

questions.q: Which example best describes a supervised learning setup?
options: A chess agent that plays millions of games against itself to improve
A model grouping news articles into topics with no predefined categories
A model trained on houses' features alongside their actual sale prices, to predict the price of a new house
A model that receives no training data of any kind
questions.explain: Pairing input features (a house's attributes) with a known correct output (its actual sale price) is the defining structure of supervised learning.
